blocks.text: Dialysis is a medical treatment that performs the essential functions of the kidneys by removing waste products, excess fluids, and electrolytes from the blood when the kidneys are no longer able to do so adequately. It is a form of renal replacement therapy used in patients with advanced chronic kidney disease or acute kidney injury.
